_note: Original-paper settings of the competitors; SHE-ABC with the budget-scaled colony. Change values here only, before the runs.

algorithms.name: random_search
algorithms.source: Bergstra & Bengio (2012), JMLR 13:281-305 - uniform sampling, no parameters

algorithms.name: abc
algorithms.source: Karaboga & Akay (2009), Appl. Math. Comput. 214:108-132 - colony size 50 (SN = 25 food sources), limit = SN*D, random scout

algorithms.name: gabc
algorithms.source: Zhu & Kwong (2010), Appl. Math. Comput. 217:3166-3173 - C = 1.5; colony size / limit as ABC

algorithms.name: de
algorithms.source: Storn & Price (1997), J. Glob. Optim. 11:341-359 - DE/rand/1/bin, NP = 10*D, F = 0.5, CR = 0.9

algorithms.name: lshade
algorithms.source: Tanabe & Fukunaga (2014), IEEE CEC - N_init = 18*D, N_min = 4, H = 6, r_arc = 2.6, p = 0.11 (paper values)

algorithms.name: eshaguabc_v6
algorithms.source: SHE-ABC. Budget-aware colony for HPO: N_init = clip(round(budget/10), 10, 5*D), N_min = max(5, N_init//2); all other parameters as in the CEC experiments
